preconditions.description: The length of the hexadecimal string S is at most 14.
At least one character in S is non-zero.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in S are valid hexadecimal digits.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or has the same length as S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' or all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', all characters in the output are valid hexadecimal digits.
If the output is not 'NO', the output is a permutation of S.
If the output is not 'NO', the sum of the numerical values of the output and S equals the numerical value of the sorted version of S.
